title: Supabase logo band
description: A small grey line of text, then a full-bleed band ruled above and below (and with side rules on a wider frame on desktop) holding grey customer wordmarks in evenly spaced 80px rows: six across in two rows on desktop, three across in four rows on phones.
notes: wordmarks take the grey of text-muted-foreground; a logo without art falls back to its name in bold display type
